distractors.reason: We say 'wait for', not 'wait on' in this sense. 'Wait for' means to stay until someone or something arrives: wait for the bus.
We say 'listen to', not 'listen on'. 'Listen to' means to pay attention to sounds or people: listen to music.
We say 'believe in', not 'believe on' in this sense. 'Believe in' means to have trust or faith in someone or something.

example_sentence: You can always ___ on your family when you feel sad.
l1_interference: Türkçe konuşanlar 'rely' fiilinden sonra 'on' edatını unutabilir ya da 'rely your family' gibi edatsız bir yapı kurabilir. Türkçede 'güvenmek' fiili çoğu zaman doğrudan nesne alır, oysa İngilizcede 'rely' her zaman 'on' ile birlikte kullanılır.
explanation: In English, 'rely' is almost always followed by the preposition 'on'. It means you trust someone or something to help you when you need it.

related_collocations.example: We depend on each other in hard times.
You can count on me to help you.
She looks after her little brother every afternoon.

memory_tip: RELY ON = trust someone to help you | WAIT FOR = stay until someone or something arrives | LISTEN TO = pay attention to sound or speech
